en: Is that a Genesect? An ancient Pokémon, rebuilt with a cannon on its back! I've only ever read about them.
A crate came in on a ship last month, marked with Team Plasma's sign. Inside were three drives made for that cannon.
They're no use to me without the Pokémon. Here, take them all!
When Genesect holds a drive, its Techno Blast takes the drive's type: fire, ice or water. Try each in turn!
How is your Genesect getting on with its drives? Give it a new one before each battle and keep your foes guessing!
